input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position: 19.1 gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty consistent with industry standards plus conformity to documentation and specifications; 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformity warranty and continuous conformity for hosted Services throughout the subscription term (better than a fixed 12 months for software); 19.3 adds malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance warranties; and 19.4 provides re-performance, repair or replacement with termination and refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. There is no "AS IS" language anywhere, and 19.5 disclaims only implied warranties and expressly states that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties. Section 6.2 supplies an additional acceptance-failure refund path. No redline needed.
